name: openai-image-mcp-for-claude
description: Generate images with OpenAI (gpt-image) and save them straight to disk.
long_description: Gives Claude a generate_image tool that uses the OpenAI Images API. Images are saved to your Pictures folder, or to any folder or file path you name, at full resolution. Claude gets the file path and a small JPEG preview, so it can see the image without a large file filling up the conversation. Quality defaults to low to keep costs down. Transparent backgrounds are supported for logos and icons.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image with OpenAI and save it to disk. Returns the saved file path and a small preview.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Your key from platform.openai.com/api-keys. Claude Desktop stores it in your system keychain. Image generation is billed by OpenAI.

output_dir.title: Save folder
output_dir.description: Where images are saved when Claude doesn't name a full path. Leave empty for your Pictures folder.
